chapters.title: Christ crucified
chapters.summary: Paul appeals to the divided church in Corinth to be united. The message of the cross is foolishness to some, but to us it is the power and wisdom of God.

chapters.title: Wisdom from the Spirit
chapters.summary: Paul came in weakness, not with clever words. Eye has not seen what God has prepared for those who love Him, but the Spirit reveals it.

chapters.title: God gives the growth
chapters.summary: Paul planted and Apollos watered, but God gave the growth. Jesus Christ is the only foundation, and you are God's temple.

chapters.title: Servants of Christ
chapters.summary: Paul and the apostles are servants and stewards, treated as the scum of the world. He urges the Corinthians to imitate him and not be proud.

chapters.title: Purity in the church
chapters.summary: The church is tolerating gross immorality. A little yeast leavens the whole lump; Christ our Passover is sacrificed for us.

chapters.title: Your body is a temple
chapters.summary: Believers should not sue each other in pagan courts. Flee sexual immorality: your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit and you were bought with a price.

chapters.title: Marriage and singleness
chapters.summary: Paul answers questions about marriage, divorce and remaining single, urging each to live as the Lord has called them.

chapters.title: Food offered to idols
chapters.summary: Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up. Believers should give up their freedom rather than cause a weaker brother to stumble.

chapters.title: All things to all people
chapters.summary: Paul gave up his rights for the gospel and became all things to all people. Run the race to win an imperishable crown.

chapters.title: Flee idolatry
chapters.summary: Israel's history is a warning. God will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. Do everything for the glory of God.

chapters.title: The Lord's Supper
chapters.summary: Paul addresses order in worship and rebukes selfishness at the Lord's Supper: do this in remembrance of me, proclaiming the Lord's death until He comes.

chapters.title: One body, many parts
chapters.summary: There are different gifts but the same Spirit. The church is one body with many members, and each one is needed.

chapters.title: The greatest is love
chapters.summary: Without love, every gift is empty. Love is patient and kind, it never fails. Now abide faith, hope and love, and the greatest of these is love.

chapters.title: Order in worship
chapters.summary: Prophecy builds up the church more than tongues without interpretation. Let everything be done decently and in order.

chapters.title: The resurrection
chapters.summary: Christ died for our sins, was buried and rose on the third day. If Christ is not raised, faith is futile. The dead will be raised: O death, where is your sting?

chapters.title: The collection and greetings
chapters.summary: Paul arranges a collection for the believers in Jerusalem and shares travel plans. Be watchful, stand firm, and let all be done with love.
